answer: The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wharf of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The trellis lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the beacon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short.
